papers.abstract: The rise of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) in the built environment is shifting attention from isolated AI tools toward autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act across project and organizational workflows. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on large language model capabilities, but also on the readiness of heterogeneous data environments across the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector. These environments combine structured sources, such as CAD and BIM models, schedules, cost databases, and asset registers, with unstructured ones, including technical reports, design narratives, planning and policy documents, contracts, meeting minutes, and risk registers. This paper reviews how built environment data can be organized to support agentic AI-ready workflows, focusing on knowledge structures, interoperability, and access and integration mechanisms such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Drawing on existing literature, it examines approaches proposed to organize structured and unstructured data and considers how such data can be contextualized and made accessible to AI agents in a reliable manner. The paper synthesizes current perspectives, highlights challenges around fragmentation and interoperability, and identifies open questions for future research on AI-compatible information management in the built environment.

summary.takeaway: 该文综述建筑环境组织如何组织结构化与非结构化数据以支持智能体AI就绪工作流，聚焦知识结构、互操作性以及RAG与MCP等访问与集成机制。
summary.methods: 基于现有文献的综述与观点综合，考察CAD/BIM、进度与成本数据库等结构化来源与技术报告、合同、会议纪要等非结构化来源的组织方式，并讨论如何将数据上下文化并可靠地提供给AI智能体。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型智能体与检索增强生成在特定行业数据环境中的落地，与检索增强与对齐主题相关。
summary.caveat: 为综述性论文，摘要未报告实证结果或定量评估；其关于挑战与开放问题的判断基于文献综合而非实验验证。

papers.title: From PID to Reinforcement Learning in Building HVAC Control: A Control-Architecture Review of Tuning Strategies, Formulations, and Deployment Trade-offs
papers.abstract: This paper reviews control architectures for building heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, addressing the tension among energy demand, occupant comfort and equipment operability, and situating proportional-integral-derivative (PID) regulation within a layered control stack that also includes rule-based and model-based supervisory control and data-driven reinforcement learning (RL). It examines the thermostat-PID layer from two-position and scheduled setpoint control through proportional, PI and PID regulation and their tuning, then formulates RL for building control as a Markov decision process. Its central contribution is a taxonomy of where RL meets PID: RL as a gain tuner for an existing loop, as a direct replacement for the regulatory controller, as a hybrid with model predictive control, and as supervisory setpoint and schedule generation. Across these classes, the review establishes that the physical loop remains invariant while the intervention point changes, and that the classes differ in their requirements for actuation authority, state information, modelling, commissioning and constraint handling. It further establishes that PID is inexpensive and well codified but limited by nonlinearity, time variation, discrete mode switching, loop interaction and slow plant dynamics, while RL's admissible position must be argued rather than assumed. The paper concludes that these architectures are not competing philosophies of control but nested points of attachment on one HVAC plant, with hybrid implementations possible, and that deployment trade-offs must be assessed according to the specific control interface and scaffolding required.

summary.takeaway: 该综述提出建筑HVAC控制中RL与PID结合的分类体系，指出物理控制回路保持不变而RL的介入点不同，并强调RL的适用位置需要论证而非默认假设。
summary.methods: 文献综述，将PID置于包含规则型、基于模型的监督控制与数据驱动RL的分层控制栈中；考察恒温器-PID层的调参，并将建筑控制中的RL形式化为马尔可夫决策过程；按RL作为增益调参器、直接替代调节控制器、与模型预测控制混合、监督设定点与日程生成四类进行归纳。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习主题直接相关，讨论RL在真实物理系统中的部署位置与权衡。
summary.caveat: 为架构综述，摘要未给出定量基准或实地部署结果；各类架构的相对优劣依赖具体控制接口与配套设施，难以从摘要直接外推。

papers.title: Bayesian Sequential Optimal Experimental Design for Single-Pixel Imaging using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging. In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way. Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

summary.takeaway: 该工作将单像素成像中的贝叶斯序贯最优实验设计重构为强化学习问题，学习从当前后验信念直接映射到下一最优二值照明图案的策略，避免在测量中直接优化复杂信息论目标。
summary.methods: 以期望信息增益为奖励，将sOED表述为RL问题；在代表性SPI成像场景下比较两种策略参数化的可扩展性，并考察仅具近似后验信息或测量受噪声影响时的性能退化，提出若干面向生物医学应用的设计约束策略。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习主题相关，展示RL用于自适应压缩感知与序贯实验设计，并涉及生物医学成像应用动机。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体重建质量或信息增益数值，实验限于简化的代表性SPI场景；向更复杂大规模SPI及真实生物医学系统的扩展仅被表述为框架可扩展，尚需验证。

papers.title: Efficient Detailed Scheduling of Multiproduct Pipelines using Action-Decoupled Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multiproduct pipelines transport refined products to delivery stations in sequential batches, and their detailed scheduling must meet market demand while respecting nonlinear hydraulic constraints. Retaining the full hydraulic nonlinearity yields a mixed-integer nonlinear program that is computationally intractable, while the linearization commonly adopted for solver-based optimization degrades hydraulic accuracy without resolving the heavy computational burden. This paper develops an action-decoupled proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that efficiently produces detailed schedules while preserving hydraulic fidelity. The scheduling process is cast as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) with flexible action durations. To handle the discrete-continuous hybrid action space, a cascaded dual-actor architecture decouples the discrete operating duration from the continuous flow decisions, eliminating the gradient interference that destabilizes conventional coupled-action policies and thereby yielding high-quality schedules far more efficiently. Validated on a real-world multiproduct pipeline in China and benchmarked against a single-actor baseline and a linearized MILP solved by Gurobi, the proposed framework achieves delivery accuracy close to the exact optimum while substantially improving flow rate stability and substantially reducing solution time.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种动作解耦的PPO框架，在保留水力非线性的前提下高效生成多产品管道详细调度方案。
summary.methods: 将调度过程建模为半马尔可夫决策过程，采用级联双演员架构解耦离散操作时长与连续流量决策；在中国实际多产品管道上验证，并与单演员基线及Gurobi求解的线性化MILP对比。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于强化学习在工业调度中的应用，展示了动作解耦PPO处理离散-连续混合动作空间的能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告相对基线的定性改进（交付精度接近最优、提高流量稳定性、大幅减少求解时间），未给出具体数值或统计显著性；验证局限于单一实际管道案例。

papers.title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Task-Free Federated Continual Forecasting via Two-Tier Replay under Concept Drift
papers.abstract: Federated time-series forecasting is increasingly important in applications where temporal data are distributed across privacy-sensitive clients, such as environmental monitoring, smart cities, and industrial sensing. A central limitation of current continual-learning protocols is that they usually assume predefined task boundaries, whereas deployed forecasting systems receive an uninterrupted stream and must decide autonomously when adaptation is necessary. This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task-free federated forecasting under concept drift. We introduce a drift-aware continual-learning protocol in which each client monitors prediction-window RMSE, calibrates a robust median threshold from the offline base period, and triggers adaptation only after persistent degradation. To mitigate forgetting, we propose a TwoTierReplay mechanism that separates fixed offline representative memory from online memory. The offline tier preserves long-term knowledge learned during the base phase, while the online tier captures recent distributional changes after drift. Experiments on the Beijing Multi-Site Air- Quality dataset with 12 clients, three forecasting targets, and three horizons show that TwoTierReplay achieves the best stability-plasticity score in all nine target-horizon configurations. It improves over the strongest baseline by approximately 11.4%. These results suggest that explicit temporal structuring of replay memory is a practical and effective mechanism for task-free federated continual forecasting.

summary.takeaway: 针对无任务边界的联邦持续预测中的灾难性遗忘，提出双层回放机制TwoTierReplay以平衡稳定性与可塑性。
summary.methods: 设计漂移感知的持续学习协议：客户端监测预测窗口RMSE，基于离线基期校准中位数阈值，持续退化后触发适应；TwoTierReplay将固定离线代表性记忆与在线记忆分离。在Beijing Multi-Site Air-Quality数据集上以12个客户端、3个预测目标和3个预测 horizon 进行实验。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接对应持续学习主题，研究联邦场景下无任务边界的时间序列持续预测与遗忘缓解。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在九个目标-horizon配置中均取得最佳稳定性-可塑性得分、较最强基线提升约11.4%，未提供各配置的详细数值或统计检验；实验限于单一空气质量数据集。

papers.title: GURU: A Hierarchical Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent System for Verification-Aware Automation of Mission-Critical Digital Engineering and Operations
papers.abstract: An AI can find a safe action faster than any human, but it must never decide what counts as safe. We present GURU, a hierarchical neuro-symbolic multi-agent system for mission-critical digital engineering and operations, built on one partition of authority: learned models propose, rank, and accelerate; a symbolic rules engine checks every consequential action against hard limits before it executes; and validated physics confirms and decides. GURU runs a workflow as a closed control loop, with Navigation, Action, and Planning agents sharing one Common Internal Language and one training factory. Nuclear, aviation, and national-security guidance now requires this pattern; a harnessed language model keeps the model at the center, GURU puts a validated reference there. In computational fluid dynamics, the workflow raised the converged-simulation rate on unseen aircraft geometries from under 1 percent to 74 percent over 100 single-attempt cases, ran 54 live cases to Mach 6 on three facilities, and an ablation put the symbolic layer at 13 points of boundary-layer capture. Knowledge-graph retrieval and role adapters raised ParaView control success from 55 to 75 percent. In space domain awareness, where a language model cannot be trusted to decide, a frozen self-supervised world model under validated propagation scored highest of five methods at conjunction risk, including fully fine-tuned language models, with several-times-lower seed variance: the trustworthy design gives up nothing in accuracy, and the recipe transferred to reactor anomaly detection. A radar-to-avoidance debris pipeline was demonstrated in stages on a 2026 reentry; the hierarchy coordinates simulated teams of 200 aircraft. Training scaled near-linearly past 1,000 Aurora nodes and ran at 8,000. The approach extends to a control-grade microreactor digital twin with validated physics, not a learned model, as the safety basis.

summary.takeaway: 提出分层神经符号多智能体系统GURU，以“学习模型提议、符号规则检查、验证物理确认”的权限划分实现任务关键工程与操作的可验证自动化。
summary.methods: 系统包含导航、行动和规划智能体，共享通用内部语言与训练工厂，以闭环控制方式运行；符号规则引擎对每个重大动作进行硬限制检查，验证物理模型做最终确认。在计算流体动力学、空间域感知和反应堆异常检测等场景中评估，并使用知识图谱检索与角色适配器控制ParaView。
summary.relevance: 该工作涉及知识图谱构建与表示（知识图谱检索提升ParaView控制成功率），并展示神经符号系统中图谱与多智能体协作的集成。
summary.caveat: 摘要来自预印本，部分结果（如100次单次尝试中收敛仿真率从不足1%提升至74%、54个 live 案例至Mach 6、边界层捕获13个百分点消融、ParaView成功率从55%到75%）未说明统计不确定性或基线细节；系统复杂度高，跨场景泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Floodwater Level Reasoning for Cloud-Edge Collaborative Monitoring
papers.abstract: Frequent urban floodwater poses a serious threat to the safety and efficiency of intelligent transportation systems. Existing vision-based methods for floodwater level detection face two main limitations. First, the lack of explicit reasoning leads to poor detection performance and little interpretability. Second, these methods struggle to generalize to the complex and varied real-world road scenes seen from different viewpoints. To address this, we reformulate the task as an explicit visual reasoning problem and propose HydroReasoner, a floodwater level reasoning framework designed for cloud-edge collaboration. HydroReasoner builds on Qwen2.5-VL and is trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. To address the scarcity of reasoning process annotations, we build a floodwater domain knowledge graph HydroKG and design a novel KG path reward. Through deterministic graph traversal over HydroKG, this reward supervises the model's reasoning process at a fine granularity, which improves both reasoning and generalization. For edge deployment, we apply 4-bit quantization to the model, cutting GPU memory usage by 57% and inference latency by 43% while out-of-domain accuracy drops by only 0.2 percentage points. We also propose a confidence-based cloud-edge routing mechanism, which improves system safety and eases the computational load on the cloud. In addition, we build HydroLevel, a floodwater benchmark dataset of 3,000 images, for training and evaluating the model. Experimental results show that HydroReasoner achieves detection accuracy 4.0 and 13.6 percentage points higher than conventional vision baselines in the in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations respectively, with performance dropping by only 4.4 percentage points out of domain.

summary.takeaway: 将洪水水位检测重构为显式视觉推理问题，提出面向云边协同的HydroReasoner框架，利用领域知识图谱路径奖励提升推理与泛化能力。
summary.methods: 基于Qwen2.5-VL，采用Group Relative Policy Optimization训练；构建洪水领域知识图谱HydroKG，设计知识图谱路径奖励通过确定性图遍历进行细粒度推理监督；边缘部署采用4-bit量化，并提出基于置信度的云边路由机制；构建包含3000张图像的HydroLevel基准数据集。
summary.relevance: 该工作同时涉及知识图谱（HydroKG用于推理监督）和强化学习（GRPO训练），与给定主题高度相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告域内和域外检测准确率分别比传统视觉基线高4.0和13.6个百分点、域外性能仅下降4.4个百分点，量化后GPU内存降低57%、推理延迟降低43%、域外准确率仅降0.2个百分点，但未说明基线具体配置、数据集多样性及统计显著性。

papers.title: CREDO: Evidence-Conditioned Credit Assignment for Temporal Reasoning Agents
papers.abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires language model agents to retrieve evidence, select relevant facts, and perform multi-step temporal reasoning. However, the trajectory-level outcome signal in GRPO does not explicitly distinguish the quality of intermediate decisions: downstream failures can penalize useful evidence acquisition, while identical rewards in all-failed groups eliminate the relative outcome signal despite differences in intermediate progress. We propose Credit Redistribution with Evidence-Driven Opportunities (CREDO), which uses intermediate evidence to recover local supervision, including in all-failed groups, and determine where outcome supervision acts. CREDO assigns positive stage-level credit through comparisons among rollouts of the same question and uses retained answer overlap as an opportunity proxy to shift part of the outcome-policy weight toward reasoning and answering. The framework preserves terminal rewards and trajectory-level advantages, while redistribution conserves total outcome-policy weight per trajectory. Following the public evaluation protocol of prior work, CREDO raises Overall accuracy from 78.0% to 82.4% and Multiple accuracy from 55.0% to 65.6% on MultiTQ relative to the strongest published baseline in our comparison. On TimelineKGQA, it raises cross-KG accuracy from 30.9% to 36.4% relative to our reproduced baseline via direct transfer to ICEWS Actor under matched training and evaluation settings.

summary.takeaway: 提出CREDO方法，利用中间证据恢复局部监督并进行信用重分配，改进时序知识图谱问答中GRPO的轨迹级信用分配。
summary.methods: CREDO通过同一问题多个rollout间的比较分配正阶段级信用，以保留的答案重叠作为机会代理，将部分结果策略权重转向推理和回答；保留终端奖励和轨迹级优势，且重分配保持每条轨迹的总结果策略权重守恒。在MultiTQ和TimelineKGQA上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作涉及大语言模型智能体在知识图谱上的时序推理，与知识图谱和大语言模型主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告MultiTQ上Overall准确率从78.0%提升至82.4%、Multiple准确率从55.0%提升至65.6%，TimelineKGQA跨KG准确率从30.9%提升至36.4%，均为相对特定基线；未提供方差、显著性检验或更广泛数据集上的验证。

papers.title: Protamine gene expression is associated with sperm motility in rams: An integrative experimental and gene network analysis.
papers.abstract: Protamine 1 (PRM1) and protamine 2 (PRM2) are essential regulators of sperm chromatin condensation and genome integrity, and their dysregulation has been associated with impaired male fertility. However, their role in rams remains insufficiently characterized. This study investigated the relationship between protamine gene expression and semen quality in rams and explored their potential upstream regulatory mechanisms using gene regulatory network (GRN) analysis. Fifteen ejaculates from five rams were analyzed. Based on total sperm motility using computer-assisted sperm analysis (CASA), ejaculates were classified into a high-motility group (n = 8) and a low-motility group (n = 7). PRM1 and PRM2 expression levels were quantified by RT-qPCR. Following normality confirmation (p > 0.05), parametric tests were applied using the ejaculate as the biological experimental unit. Samples with reduced motility showed significantly lower expression of both protamines (p < 0.01). Moreover, progressive sperm motility was strongly correlated with both PRM1 (r = 0.71, p = 0.019) and PRM2 (r = 0.69, p = 0.03) transcript levels. Cross-species GRN inference using scGeneRAI and a reference human spermatogenesis dataset identified several hypothesis-generating candidate transcription factors, including HMGB4, HMGB1, H2AFZ, NKX6-1, and SMC3, consistently supported across multiple bootstrap resampling runs. These findings demonstrate a strong association between protamine expression and sperm motility in rams. While the identified candidate regulators provide a valuable framework for future species-specific validation, they also highlight promising candidate molecular biomarkers of male fertility in livestock.

summary.takeaway: 在公羊中发现精蛋白基因PRM1和PRM2表达与精子活力显著相关，并通过跨物种基因调控网络推断提出候选上游转录因子。
summary.methods: 分析5只公羊的15次射精样本，根据CASA总精子活力分为高活力组（n=8）和低活力组（n=7），RT-qPCR定量PRM1/PRM2表达；使用scGeneRAI和人类精子发生参考数据集进行跨物种GRN推断，并通过多次bootstrap重采样支持候选转录因子。
summary.relevance: 该研究属于GRN/Regulon主题，利用基因调控网络分析探索精蛋白基因的上游调控机制。
summary.caveat: 样本量小（5只公羊、15次射精），GRN推断为跨物种假设生成性质，候选调控因子（如HMGB4、HMGB1等）需物种特异性实验验证；相关性不等于因果。

papers.title: In vitro phenotyping and genomics: a conceptual framework linking plant tissue culture with GWAS, QTL mapping, and multi-omics.
papers.abstract: Standardized in vitro phenotypes provide genetically tractable traits that integrate GWAS, QTL mapping, and multi-omics, enabling mechanistic insight and genetics-informed improvement of plant regeneration. Plant tissue culture (PTC) has traditionally been employed as a technical tool for propagation, transformation, and germplasm conservation. This review reframes in vitro culture systems as quantitative phenotyping platforms that enable rigorous genetic dissection of complex traits, such as regeneration competence, stress tolerance, and developmental plasticity. By operating under highly standardized and reproducible conditions, in vitro systems reduce environmental noise and expose genotype-dependent variation that is often obscured in field or greenhouse experiments. When formalized as quantitative traits, culture responses, including callus induction, organogenesis, somatic embryogenesis, and stress survival, become amenable to genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and quantitative trait locus (QTL) mapping. Synthesizing evidence across diverse plant species, this review demonstrates that in vitro traits are genetically structured, polygenic, and biologically meaningful, reflecting coordinated regulation of hormonal signaling, chromatin accessibility, stress response pathways, and developmental gene networks. Numerous GWAS and QTL studies have identified loci and candidate genes underlying regeneration efficiency, embryogenic competence, and stress-responsive culture performance, confirming that tissue culture responsiveness is rooted in genomic architecture rather than protocol effects alone. The interpretive power of genetic mapping is substantially enhanced through integration with bioinformatic and multi-omics layers, including transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and network-based analyses, thereby refining candidate prioritization and facilitating mechanistic inference. This review further examines the dual role of somaclonal variation as both a constraint on clonal fidelity and a source of genetic and epigenetic diversity that can reveal cryptic genotype-phenotype relationships. Emphasis is placed on study design principles, phenotyping challenges, statistical modeling strategies, and integrative pipelines that connect genotype to in vitro phenotype and ultimately to breeding and biotechnology applications. This synthesis highlights in vitro culture systems as powerful, genetics-informed platforms for precision breeding, gene validation, and supporting efforts to more predictably and rationally manipulate complex traits, particularly in horticultural and clonally propagated crops.

summary.takeaway: 综述提出将植物组织培养系统作为定量表型平台，整合GWAS、QTL定位和多组学以解析再生能力等复杂性状的遗传基础。
summary.methods: 综述综合跨物种证据，论证体外性状具有多基因遗传结构，并讨论将转录组、表观基因组、蛋白组、代谢组和网络分析与遗传作图整合的策略；同时探讨体细胞克隆变异的双重作用及研究设计、表型挑战和统计建模。
summary.relevance: 该综述涉及机制推理，强调通过多组学和网络分析从基因型到体外表型再到育种应用的整合推理 pipeline。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，未报告新的原始实验结果或具体数值；所提出的整合框架需在具体作物系统中验证。

papers.title: Rice bZIP11 acts as a transcriptional repressor that negatively regulates photosynthesis in response to nitrogen deficiency.
papers.abstract: Nitrogen (N)-deficiency responses, which are closely linked to plant biomass and crop yield, differ between plant tissues. A previous in silico analysis suggested that four transcription factors, including OsbZIP11, play vital roles in the gene regulatory network governing N-deficiency responses (NDRs) in rice roots. To investigate the role of OsbZIP11 in NDRs, the phenotypes, functional responses, and gene expression of rice plants that either lacked functional OsbZIP11 or overexpressed OsbZIP11 were analyzed. Contrary to expectations, OsbZIP11 function showed an overwhelmingly stronger association with photosynthetic gene expression than with any other physiological process, including the expression control of N-related genes. OsbZIP11 directly suppressed numerous photosynthetic genes as a transcriptional repressor. N deficiency increased OsbZIP11 expression in shoots, consistent with N deficiency-reduced photosynthetic activity. Furthermore, removing functional OsbZIP11 and OsbZIP11 overexpression produced opposite effects on the expression of genes involved in the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis and carbon dioxide fixation, as well as on growth and grain yield. These findings indicate that OsbZIP11 is a critical factor responsible for N deficiency-induced decreases in photosynthesis in rice and provide new insights into the mechanism underlying the coordination of C and N acquisition.

summary.takeaway: 发现水稻转录因子OsbZIP11作为转录抑制子负调控光合作用，是氮缺乏诱导光合下降的关键因子。
summary.methods: 分析缺失功能OsbZIP11或过表达OsbZIP11的水稻植株的表型、功能响应和基因表达；此前in silico分析提示OsbZIP11参与水稻根系氮缺乏响应基因调控网络。
summary.relevance: 该研究属于GRN/Regulon主题，揭示转录因子在氮缺乏响应基因调控网络中的功能角色。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明实验具体条件、样本量或统计细节；OsbZIP11直接抑制众多光合基因的机制细节及田间条件下的适用性需进一步研究。

papers.title: NIR: Approximate Neural Instance Retrieval for ALCIQ
papers.abstract: Instance retrieval is the main bottleneck of concept-learning systems based on refinement operators. We present NIR, a family of neural instance retrievers for ALCIQ that output graded membership scores from knowledge graph embeddings. We compare tokenization-based encoders (GRU, LSTM, Transformer) with a Compositional encoder that mirrors DL operators via primitive sub-networks. On eight benchmarks, all variants approximate Pellet closely on complete knowledge bases, while the Transformer model is most robust under incompleteness. The source code of our approach is at https://github.com/dice-group/owlapy.

summary.takeaway: 提出NIR，一族用于ALCIQ的神经实例检索器，从知识图谱嵌入输出分级隶属度分数，以近似推理机Pellet的实例检索结果，在八个基准上所有变体在完整知识库上接近Pellet，Transformer在知识库不完整时最稳健。
summary.methods: 使用知识图谱嵌入产生分级隶属度分数；比较了基于标记化的编码器（GRU、LSTM、Transformer）与通过原始子网络镜像描述逻辑操作符的组合编码器；在八个基准数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作面向知识图谱中的实例检索，属于知识图谱推理与概念学习系统，与给定主题“知识图谱”直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在完整知识库上所有变体接近Pellet、Transformer在不完整时最稳健，未给出具体精度或速度数值；组合编码器的比较细节与整体性能限制未充分说明。
